title: feat(record-page): dense field rows, one-line activity and file-row attachments

Fixes #35602
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户在记录详情页看到更紧凑的字段（标签在左、值在右、按宽度两到三列）、按天分组的一行式动态，以及一行一个文件的附件列表；评论框平时只占一行。
- 属于记录页改版：同一屏能看到更多字段、动态和附件，少滚动。
- 出错时最多是版面挤或时间换行，数据不受影响；改动只在界面，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- **Fields** (default record page, frameless face; drawn by `DetailSection.tsx`, `DetailView.tsx` untouched): each field is one 32px row, label left (12px, muted, 112px fixed width) and value right (13px, 24px line so badges fit). Columns are 1 / 2 / 3 by container width (`@xl` 2, `@4xl` 3) under the existing cap: 2 beside the right column, 3 in the wide tier; sections with five or fewer fields stay at 2. Groups stay collapsible; the #35019 empty-group line is unchanged. Authored pages that ask for bordered group cards keep them.
- **Activity** (stream and authored panel): the comment box is one line (34px) until focused. Entries sit under day headings (今天 / 昨天 / date). System entries are ~30px one-line rows (icon, who, what, time on the right); comments are a header plus one body line (50px), with reactions and 「回复」 on hover or focus. Consecutive field edits by one person on one day fold into one expandable row (display only). An approval is one line with 「看审批」 when the host passes `onViewApprovals`. The panel's 全部 filter becomes a quiet text trigger in its header; the stream keeps its chips.
- **Behaviour change:** the reply input opens behind a per-comment 「回复」 toggle instead of standing open under every comment.
- **Attachments:** 33px file rows (type icon, name, size, uploader, date, ⋮ menu with Download and Delete). 「+ 上传」 at the top right; files can be dropped anywhere on the panel; the empty state is one 40px dashed line with 「选择文件」. The uploader name shows for the viewer's own files or when `uploaded_by` arrives expanded; otherwise the cell is blank (a server-side expand is out of scope). No Rename (no rename seam on the panel).
- **i18n:** 7 new `detail.*` keys in all 11 locale packs.
- Two small optional props serve the comment box and comment row: `compact` on `RichTextCommentInput`, `controlsClassName` on `CommentBody`.

## Follow-ups (nested under #35602)

- #35724: the uploader name on other people's files (needs a server-side expand) and the Rename item in the row ⋮ menu (needs a rename route). Both are card item 3 parts this UI-only PR cannot reach.
- #35723: an approval feed producer in plugin-approvals, so the one-line approval row appears and 「看审批」 opens the Approvals tab. Until then the row is a host-supplied affordance (seat ruling).

Only the default record page went dense; authored pages that ask for the card face keep their cards (seat ruling).

## Acceptance notes (1280×800 zh-CN, real browser)

| Line | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Field rows (default page, account) | label above value, first row 52px | 9 / 9 rows at 32px, 0 card faces |
| Comment box | 129px | 34px |
| Activity entries fully in the first screen (stream) | 1 | 7 (a run of 7 edits folded into one row) |
| Authored panel (project) | composer 129px, fold rows 70px | composer 34px, fold 30px |
| Attachments, empty | 131px | 76px (36px header + 40px dashed line) |
| Attachments, 3 files | 233px, rows 57 / 57 / 56 | 136px, rows 33 / 33 / 33 |
| 380px drawer | — | 1 column of label-left rows, nothing past the edge, no horizontal scroll; times on one line |

Not measured: the column count in the default 720px drawer.

## Tests

- New: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/denseActivityRows-35602.test.tsx` (fold rule, fold expand, day grouping, comment header, approval line with 看审批, collapsed composer).
- Migrated (old layout pins moved to the new rows; none deleted, negative pins re-anchored so they stay non-vacuous):
  - plugin-detail: `narrowDrawerTime-34614`, `recordPageV3Face-27055`, `recordTimelineStream-27055`, `RecordActivityTimeline.authorControls-12268`, `RecordActivityTimeline.reactionsCommentRowsOnly-11035`, `RecordActivityTimeline.zeroReplyInput-12144`, `RecordTimelinePanel.chatterInset-34676`
  - app-shell attachments: `RecordAttachmentsPanel.test.tsx`, `RecordAttachmentsPanel.affordanceGrant-12047`, `RecordAttachmentsPanel.deleteConfirm-12248`
  - app-shell record view: `RecordDetailView.authoredActivityThreading-12249`, `.replyCountOnRead-12144`, `.feedCommentEditDelete-12268`, `.commentWriteFailure-10899`, `.withheldMentions-28218`, `.recordPageTiers-26678`
  - e2e: `narrow-drawer-time-34614.spec.ts`, `record-flow-phone-targets.spec.ts`
- Checklist: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/attachments-storage.json` item `attachments-storage.download-authz-both-sides`: step 6 now reaches Download through the row ⋮ menu; revision 11 → 12 with a history row. No clause changed.

## Verification

- `vitest run` over plugin-detail, i18n and the attachments panel tests: 499 files passed, 1 skipped; 5,555 tests passed, 31 skipped.
- e2e narrow-drawer pins (#34614, #34696, #34826) plus `record-flow-phone-targets`: 25 passed.
- Type-check plugin-detail, i18n and app-shell: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates`: 48 derived, 48 run, all exit 0.
- `overlap-check`: clean against main; no shared file with the record tabs/rail branch.
- CI on `894bd7758a`: 50 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed.
- Screenshots before/after at 1280×800 and in a 380px drawer are in the area's run folder.
